documentation.description: Classify source text against caller-defined labels and rubrics. Input-only billing; no output-token charge.
documentation.input_format: Send the native task JSON object as the content of one user message. Summarize also accepts plain text. Text only; tools, chat history, response_format, and image blocks are not supported by this adapter.
documentation.output_format: A JSON object in choices[0].message.content, including native task results. Stream responses deliver the completed result together, not incremental upstream tokens. Usage reports the provider's billable input tokens; completion_tokens is zero.
